title: Python: enum dict lookups need exhaustiveness checks
description: Python uses dict.get() with fallback defaults for enum-to-string mappings (e.g. _ORIGIN_REJECT_TO_REASON in dao_manager.py). New enum variants silently return the generic fallback. Fix: replace .get(key, default) with direct dict[key] where ALL variants should be covered — KeyError beats silent generic. Or add tests asserting len(mapping) == len(EnumClass) for each such dict.
